answer: Re-attestations are stored in echo and spiral lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the inlet graph. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 18 epochs, so holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 747 impostors cost 1090 times the honest price and take 2 times as long to clear. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
